name: starboard
description: AI-powered Databricks workload analysis: queries, jobs, Unity Catalog, clusters, FinOps, warehouses, and diagnostics. Skills-only CLI-helper mode — no server required.

enable_mcp.title: Enable Starboard MCP server (full agent stack)
enable_mcp.description: Runs starboard-mcp for server-side orchestration of the full 7-agent stack. Requires LLM credentials (LLM_PROVIDER / LLM_API_KEY / LLM_MODEL). Leave off to use the skills-only path via the starboard-helper CLI.
